# Dialectic of Enlightenment

*[Horkheimer](../philosophers/horkheimer.md) · 1947 · *Dialektik der Aufklärung**

A book written in exile by [Horkheimer](../philosophers/horkheimer.md) and [Adorno](../philosophers/adorno.md) (first version 1944, published 1947): Enlightenment reason, having become an instrument of domination, turns back into myth. It contains the famous critique of the "culture industry".
